## Summary

Repositions projectboki.com from a creature-collecting game to a **skill-based PvPvE extraction game for PC**. Playtesters said "creature-catching game" felt like mobile slop, so the copy, structure and visuals now follow the extraction pitch. Visual direction takes cues from Palworld's site: bright daylight, big key-art screenshots, one headline plus one image per section, bold readable type.

**Do not merge yet.** This needs your approval, plus the Discord invite (see To do).

### Section order (follows the five pillars)
| # | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero: logo, tagline, creature-raising pitch, Boki cutouts | **Hero: a squad mid-fight with their Boki.** Tagline on three lines, Tarkov / SUPERVIVE / Monster Rancher comparison, playtest + GitHub buttons |
| 2 | Scrolling ticker | **Stakes:** "Every run risks your Boki." |
| 3 | Two halves (farm / expedition) | **How a run works:** Drop in, Fight and explore, Find or tame a Boki, Extract or lose it |
| 4 | Meet the Boki (9-Boki lineup with picker) | **Skill:** "Kits win fights. Not stats." Six archetypes in three weights |
| 5 | Features grid (9 cards) | **Your Boki:** one example card (Ember): size, personality, markings, where hatched, what it survived |
| 6 | Shimmering lineup screenshot | **The Skylands:** the Wyrm, the Sundering, Boki as wildlife |
| 7 | Make a Boki (JSON) | **Fair play:** a short dedicated list |
| 8 | Roadmap | **Community:** "Played SUPERVIVE? Join the playtest." Discord + GitHub |
| 9 | FAQ | removed |
| 10 | Follow the build CTA | merged into Community |

### Visuals
- Every image is a new in-game capture from `OrriBogdan2/project-boki`: real fights, the sky-skiff extraction, boss lairs, the prologue's Wyrm and Sundering, and a 1080p flyover video. No SUPERVIVE or third-party art.
- Removed: creature lineups on plain backgrounds, element-coloured glows, rarity and shimmer styling, the ticker.
- New palette: white and sky-blue base, navy ink, sun-orange buttons, deep navy bands for the skill and Skylands sections. Body text is bold and full-contrast (no small grey text).
- Each sentence in a headline starts on its own line.
- In-game nameplates (which include rarity words like "Uncommon") are hidden in every capture.

## Every copy change

### Page meta
- Title: "Project Boki: Raise them. Risk them. Bring them home." → "Project Boki: a PvPvE extraction game for PC"
- Description: "...an open-source creature-raising farm and PvPvE extraction game built in Godot. Raise Boki at home, take them on expeditions, and bring them back alive." → "Project Boki is a skill-based PvPvE extraction game for PC. Your Boki comes on every run, and you can lose it. Raise them. Risk them. Bring them home."
- Social description: "...An open-source creature-raising farm and PvPvE extraction game." → "A skill-based PvPvE extraction game for PC. Raise them. Risk them. Bring them home."
- Social image: dusk ship scene → the squad fight screenshot

### Navigation
- "Boki / Features / Make a Boki / Roadmap / Press kit / GitHub" → "The run / Combat / Your Boki / The Skylands / Fair play / GitHub" (the button becomes "Playtest" once the Discord invite is set). Press kit moves to the footer.

- H1 is now the tagline, one sentence per line: "Raise them." / "Risk them." / "Bring them home."
